annotations.title: Building regulations, Part L and planning flags

description: England and Wales. Says whether a roofing job is notifiable to building control (re-covering 25% or more of a roof, a change of covering, structural work, rooflights, dormers, solar, new roofs), whether Part L wants the whole roof insulated (England: more than 50% of the roof or more than 25% of the whole envelope renovated, target 0.16 W/m2K from Approved Document L; Wales: over 25%), who signs it off (competent person scheme such as CompetentRoofer, or building control), and flags for listed buildings, conservation areas, Article 4, flats, bats and asbestos. Each answer cites the official source. Typical call: {"nation":"england","work_type":"re_cover_pitched","percent_of_roof":100,"insulation":"ceiling_level","competent_person_scheme_member":true}.

changes_external_appearance.description: Will the roof look noticeably different?

competent_person_scheme_member.description: Is the roofer registered with a roofing competent person scheme (for example CompetentRoofer)?

insulation.description: Where the roof insulation is or will be.

new_covering_weight_change_percent.description: How much heavier (+) or lighter (-) the new covering is, percent.

percent_of_roof.description: Share of this roof's area being stripped, re-covered or repaired, 0 to 100. Needed for re-covering and repairs.

percent_of_whole_envelope.description: Optional: share of the whole building envelope (walls, roof, floor) being renovated, for the major renovation test.

trade.description: Optional. The roofer's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to put the contractor on risk notes and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Ridge Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Hilltop Roofing".

licence_body.description: Competent person scheme or trade body the business is registered with (CompetentRoofer is the roofing scheme run by the NFRC).
